hook: Insightful or Mera Work? $8 vs $3 a seat 👀
summary: Two employee monitoring tools, side by side. Insightful starts at $8 per seat a month and keeps 24 months of data. Mera Work is $3 per user a month with every feature included, but keeps about 3 months of data. Both prices are billed yearly.
points: 10 people: about $960 a year on Insightful vs $360 on Mera Work (list prices)
Insightful: capacity analysis, 7-day trial with no card, free live demo
Mera Work: one plan with every feature, $4 per user if you pay monthly
offer: The full comparison has the cost for 10, 25 and 50 people.
caveat: Based on each vendor's published pricing, not a hands-on test. Any monitoring tool needs a clear, honest policy with your staff.

Choosing an employee monitoring tool for a small team?

Insightful: $8/seat/mo billed yearly, 24 months of data, capacity analysis, 7-day trial.
